purpose: Explain the raw-versus-accepted complete-command recall/F1 gap under the user's OptionB-only command contract, without any fitting or evaluation-to-training reassignment.

scope.membership: Exact canonical complete typed command, not intent-only or a subset of keywords.
scope.reference_projection: Keep every original row and eligibility flag. A valid original positive outside the 31 typed commands is an explicitly identified outside-OptionB negative for this task; original UNKNOWNs remain separate; ambiguous references remain unscored.
scope.wording: Paraphrases remain positives whenever the reference typed command is in OptionB. Also report exact normalized verbatims separately; do not discard difficult wording.

ranked_hypotheses: The auxiliary intent head either disagrees with a correct finite-command candidate or matches it below the fixed .95 threshold; a first-rejection string alone conflates these cases.
Required-slot or target confidence gates discard otherwise correct candidates; test these independently, without rescuing rejected intents.
Removing extension-command competition may alter finite-command ranking and conditional slot confidence, but cannot itself repair the unchanged intent-head predictions.
Including extension references in the earlier denominator or a metric-accounting bug explains part of the reported recall/F1 gap; independently reconcile TP, FP and FN.

arms.catalog: Unchanged full shipping catalog and fixed application policy; fresh replay must reproduce the stored original/stress baseline.
Same inference as full_catalog_fixed; an explicit post-policy allowlist only rejects outputs outside all 31 OptionB commands. No command substitution or intent rescue.

One deterministic in-memory subset: retain every existing alias whose complete typed command is in the OptionB set and retain every existing null-command/negative competitor. Do not add aliases from holdout, restrict by a row's expected answer, remove negative competitors, or renormalize the semantic head.

replay.original: All 196 frozen original holdout recordings; human and synthetic strata remain separate.
replay.stress: Repeat the parent's three predeclared silence probes on all 94 eligible original-human parents. These 282 dependent derived trials are not new recordings or spoken-word robustness evidence.
replay.controls: Identical model, frontend, normalization, PCM, confidence policy, semantic label order and CPU settings across inference arms. Bind the source, model, manifest and research catalog identities before any new inference.

metrics: original UNKNOWN and outside-OptionB false accepts separately
per-intent and all-93-verbatim coverage with explicit zero-evidence cells
intent-head agreement versus matched-head underconfidence versus slot/target losses
paired catalog changes and paired silence changes
holdout_exposure: Previously examined regression corpus, including prior investigation and current read-only baseline accounting. This new bounded diagnostic is not blind qualification or a model/policy selection experiment.
protected: All parent protected identities plus the actual historical fitting/evaluation manifests, original cached replay, current bundle, normalization, recipes, frozen labels and new pre-replay bindings. Verify before and after. Do not modify any training row, label, split, installed asset or historical result.
